2607.26639.title: Borrowed Strength: Best-of-N Search over a Code EncodingBreaks Self-Check Jailbreak Defenses
2607.26639.paper_summary: A self-check defense asks the target model to assess a request before answering it; SAGE, the strongest published instance, reports an average 99% defense success rate. We show it can be breached by composing two attacks that are individually harmless against it: an established code-completion encoding and an established best-of-N search, neither of which exceeds 4.7% of behaviors alone. Composed, with the search budget spent on the encoding, they reach 67/22/15% across three open targets, and the effect persists on a 70B target. We then explain the composition rather than only reporting it. First, a self-check defense borrows its strength from the target: SAGE does not detect the attack, it asks the model to, and the four targets convert that request into an explicit refusal between 32% and 97% of the time, which orders the spread in defended coverage even though undefended reach is near-identical. Second, which attack survives is decided by the type of defense, and it inverts: against transform defenses the code encoding retains far more of its undefended reach than the character search, while against gate defenses the ordering flips. We account for this with the number of independent probes an attack delivers to a defense's decision boundary. Finally, we report a validity defect we found and repaired in our own pipeline, a deterministic attack under greedy decoding has no best-of-N variation channel at all, and give the one-line diagnostic that detects it. All claims rest on 310,000 generations scored by a human-validated judge.
2607.26639.paper_summary_zh: 自我檢查防禦要求目標模型在回答請求之前先進行評估；SAGE，最強的已發表實例，報告的平均防禦成功率為99%。我們展示了它可以被兩個對其個別無害的攻擊組合突破：一個是已建立的代碼補全編碼，另一個是已建立的最佳-N搜索，這兩者單獨的行為都不超過4.7%。組合後，將搜索預算用於編碼，它們在三個公開目標上達到67/22/15%的效果，這一效應在70B目標上仍然持續。我們接著解釋這一組合，而不僅僅是報告它。首先，自我檢查防禦的力量來自於目標：SAGE不檢測攻擊，而是要求模型進行檢測，而四個目標將該請求轉化為明確拒絕的概率在32%到97%之間，這使得防禦覆蓋的擴展有序，儘管未防禦的範圍幾乎相同。其次，哪種攻擊能夠存活由防禦類型決定，並且這一情況會反轉：對於變換防禦，代碼編碼保留了比字符搜索更多的未防禦範圍，而對於閘防禦，排序則顛倒。我們通過攻擊向防禦決策邊界提供的獨立探測數量來解釋這一點。最後，我們報告了在我們自己的管道中發現並修復的有效性缺陷，一種在貪婪解碼下的確定性攻擊根本沒有最佳-N變異通道，並給出檢測它的一行診斷。所有的主張都基於310,000次由經過人工驗證的評判者評分的生成。
